web-guide-idea-94.audience: Readers who want thoughtful conversation in a familiar language.
web-guide-idea-94.offer: Facilitate a discussion of one book or agreed section. People are paying for the hosted group and exchange of perspectives.
web-guide-idea-94.steps.0: Choose a reading scope and send prompts.
web-guide-idea-94.steps.1: Invite different responses with fair speaking time.
web-guide-idea-94.steps.2: Connect themes and choose a next discussion focus.
web-guide-idea-94.equipment: A phone and a lawful copy of the book. Avoid distributing copyrighted books or long extracts.
web-guide-idea-94.returnReason: Build a reading calendar and let members suggest future selections.
web-guide-idea-94.promotion: Name the book, language and pages or chapters to read beforehand.

web-guide-idea-94.metadataDescription: Discuss a chosen book and invite different perspectives in English or an Indian language. Learn what to offer, how to start and what equipment you need.
